anomaly_signals.detail: 209 errors out of 530 spans (~39.4% error rate) and 213 genai_tool_failures recorded — tool-executor is in a meltdown state, failing nearly 2 in 5 calls.
213 errors out of 510 spans (~41.8% error rate), directly correlated with tool-executor failures — agent tasks are cascading into errors as tools fail to respond.
24 errors out of 255 spans (~9.4% error rate), likely propagated upstream from agent-service/tool-executor failures disrupting orchestrated workflows.
p99 latency of 17,601.6 ms (~17.6s) across the stack is consistent with LLM calls stalling while waiting on broken tool calls or retrying failed tool responses.
35 token truncation events detected — tool failure retries and error payloads may be inflating context windows, causing responses to be cut short.
14 errors out of 397 spans (~3.5% error rate) — minor but notable; could indicate tool-executor failures affecting payment-related tool calls.

recommended_action: Immediately investigate and restart the tool-executor service — with a ~40% error rate and 213 confirmed GenAI tool failures, it is the blast radius epicentre. Engage circuit-breaker logic on agent-service to stop cascading failures into workflow-orchestrator and llm-gemini. Review tool timeout configs and retry budgets to prevent LLM context bloat (evidenced by 35 token truncations). Monitor payments-service closely for further degradation.
summary: A tool_meltdown scenario is active and confirmed: tool-executor and agent-service are both experiencing ~40% error rates, accounting for the bulk of the 495 error spans (6.3% overall). The p99 latency of 17.6 seconds reflects severe downstream stalling across the LLM and orchestration layers, with 213 tool failures and 35 token truncations compounding the impact.
